sticker.def: a small piece of paper with glue on the back

submarine.def: a ship that travels under water

suitcase.def: a case for carrying clothes when travelling

sunk.def: gone below the surface (past participle of sink)

superstar.def: an extremely famous performer or athlete

sweater.def: a knitted garment for the upper body

swollen.def: larger than normal because of injury

transplant.def: to move an organ or plant to a new place

tray.def: a flat board for carrying food and drinks

troll.def: an ugly creature in stories; a person who posts to provoke

tug.def: to pull hard; a boat that pulls ships

turnout.def: the number of people who vote or attend

undo.def: to reverse an action; to untie

visibility.def: how far you can see; being noticed

waitress.def: a woman who serves food in a restaurant

warmth.def: the state of being warm; friendliness
